newsitem.title: USA: Merrill picks 17 bank stocks for global list.
newsitem.headline: Merrill picks 17 bank stocks for global list.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc published a list of 17 global bank stocks it said were the top picks of its international team of analysts.

Merrill Lynch said in general it was positive on bank stocks in the United Kingdom, the United States, South Africa and certain industrialized European countries. Merrill Lynch said it had positive near term views on Southeast Asia banks and certain Latin American bank stocks.
Merrill Lynch said it is neutral at best on bank stocks in Japan, France, Germany, Italy and Canada.
However Bank of Montreal was one of the 17 "top picks." Merrill said it expects improvements at Bank of Montreal's U.S. unit Harris, which accounts for about 25 percent of overall earnings.

In the case of Japan, Merril Lynch said its view of the banks is generally negative, and the firm recommends an underweighting of 11 percent versus the Japanese bank sector's 20 percent market capitalization.
The Merrill Lynch List included three U.S. banks, Citicorp, Chase Manhattan corp and Republic New York Corp.
In the U.K., Merrill Lynch said top picks were Barclays Plc and Standard Chartered Plc.
In Latin America, Merrill's top picks were Chile's Banco BHIF, Banco Itau SA in Brazil, Bladex in Panama and Grupo Financiero Inbursa in Mexico.
On the European continent, Merrill Lynch picked Belgium's Kredietbank NV.
Merrill Lynch said it was quite positive on South African banks for the next 12 to 18 months and named two to its list, ABSA and Nedcor LTD.

In Australia Merrill Lynch said its pick was National Australia Bank Ltd, which it said has a consistent record of cost control, management of credit quality, and leadership in systems and product development.
In Asia, Merrill said its list includes Singapore's DBS Bank and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp Ltd, and in Thailand, Thai Farmers Bank Ltd.
